card.name: Athletic training and strength talk
card.fires_on: Words in athletic training text about athletes, strength, plyometrics and drills, often just before an exercise word is expected (e.g. 'able to', 'type of', 'foam').

modes.label: Linking words about athletes
modes.description: Small words like 'to' or 'a' in sentences about what an athlete must be able to do.
modes.example: the thought was that an athlete must be able to squat two and a half times their own bodyweight to be able<< to>> perform plyometrics.
